run_generate_c_code: run the script to generate C code using a Mistral model constrained by an EBNF grammar
create_incremental_grammar_constraint: create an IncrementalGrammarConstraint from an EBNF grammar string to constrain token generation
create_grammar_logits_processor: create a GrammarConstrainedLogitsProcessor to enforce grammar rules during model generation
generate_grammar_constrained_text: generate text from a causal language model using a grammar-constrained logits processor
decode_generated_tokens: decode generated token IDs back to human-readable text using the tokenizer batch_decode method
